propositions: Optional configuration key enforce_plan_material_pins with fail-open behavior must be registered on VerifyConfig and readable via dedicated _read_enforce_plan_material_pins boundary that catches ConfigError and logs structured warning.

Derived plan-material-pin health contract must aggregate target pin statuses by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and report legacy-unpinned only when wholly unpinned.

When enforcement is enabled, pin drift, malformed pins, or missing pinned targets must invalidate the attestation; when disabled, the same observations must be reported as advisory without changing valid status.

Full LLM plan-review must thread pre-LLM related_material snapshot through sidecar.emit and build_payload as optional reviewed_related_material field while preserving plan_review_result_v2 schema and legacy-unpinned compatibility.
Re-sign recovery must parse reviewed_related_material from sidecar without certified attestation and invoke derive_plan_material_pin_health with enforcement to guard sign decisions.

drift_refresh_candidate must pass full ticket_state and verified attestation to compute_validity with DRIFT_REFRESH profile (which disables code freshness only) before qualifying code drift, delegating signature/kind/reopen/registry/own-material/pin checks.
